from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    line_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    line_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2).most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, background)]
    color = grid[points[0][0]][points[0][1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if line_row is not None:
        if min(r for r, c in points) > line_row:
            dr = line_row + 1 - min(r for r, c in points)
            shifted = [(r + dr, c) for r, c in points]
            axis = max(r for r, c in shifted) + 1
        else:
            dr = line_row - 1 - max(r for r, c in points)
            shifted = [(r + dr, c) for r, c in points]
            axis = min(r for r, c in shifted) - 1
        for r, c in points:
            out[r][c] = background
        out[axis] = [8] * w
    else:
        if min(c for r, c in points) > line_col:
            dc = line_col + 1 - min(c for r, c in points)
            shifted = [(r, c + dc) for r, c in points]
            axis = max(c for r, c in shifted) + 1
        else:
            dc = line_col - 1 - max(c for r, c in points)
            shifted = [(r, c + dc) for r, c in points]
            axis = min(c for r, c in shifted) - 1
        for r, c in points:
            out[r][c] = background
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][axis] = 8
    for r, c in shifted:
        out[r][c] = color
    return out
